items.title: Nvidia Isn’t the Only Hero the Stock Market Needs Right Now
items.summary: Only time will tell which ends up being more exciting, but Nvidia has half a chance.  The artificial-intelligence trade, and chip stocks in particular, have faltered in recent weeks and need a timely boost from the world’s most valuable company.  Intuit  earnings have brought the sector more pain, reigniting fears over the impact of AI disruption.
